recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat any future removal or normalization of orphaned valueset-birth-sex.xml as separate source cleanup with build-system confirmation, not as a FHIR-18848 reconciliation fix.
issue_request: FHIR-18848 asked Patient Care to replace the Birth Sex value set's administrative-gender male/female framing with XX/XY/other. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification decision kept administrative-gender and the male/female code displays, but included other by removing the exclusion of administrative-gender#other.
initial_application: The issue family was applied in STU3/R4-era FamilyMemberHistory work: 04c4d675c5f4 included FHIR-18848 in the FamilyMemberHistory.sex binding changes, 2bf5371d7642 added other to the FamilyMemberHistory.sex wording, and later FHIR-20393 commits 0b584258d4 and 88c9c65a corrected the binding URL to the canonical administrative-gender value set.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists FamilyMemberHistory as active, and source/familymemberhistory/structuredefinition-FamilyMemberHistory.xml binds FamilyMemberHistory.sex extensibly to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/administrative-gender with short text male | female | other | unknown. The old source/familymemberhistory/valueset-birth-sex.xml still contains the historical is-not-a other filter, but source searches found no current references beyond that file and source/oids.ini, and current build.fhir.org/hl7.org valueset-birth-sex URLs return 404. FHIR-19716 was resolved as a duplicate/no-change of this same decision, FHIR-20393 is already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-43360 later reaffirmed the sex name and extensible administrative-gender binding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active built resource already allows administrative-gender#other, and editing the unreferenced/out-of-build Birth Sex value set source would not correct current specification behavior.
